UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific data, including application credits.

credits.description: The number of credits the user has available.

BackupFile.title: Backup File
BackupFile.description: Metadata for a user's backed-up BIN file.

name.description: The name of the backup file.

storagePath.description: The full path to the file in Firebase Storage.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the backup was created.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this backup.

/users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.description: Stores metadata for file backups belonging to a specific user.
